notes.title: The Mondrian Gallery...
notes.notes:
We've just added The Mondrian Gallery to the demo version of Mondrian Squares.  The Mondrian Gallery showcases work from art students all over the world, along with art selected by our sponsors and ourselves.

We would like to send a huge thank you to everyone that helped to make this happen.

Check it out on our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1823910/Mondrian_Squares/]store page[/url].

Please note that The Mondrian Gallery is currently only available in the demo and not in the full game.

Enjoy ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Halloween Spooktacular
notes.notes:
From the beginning of October for 5 weeks you will have the option of playing a Halloween-themed version of Mondrian Squares, featuring a spooky soundtrack, a creepy backdrop and Halloween-themed tiles.

Don't forget to collect all the special Halloween achievements.

Enjoy ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Sci-fi Spectacular
notes.notes:
To celebrate Star Wars day on May 4th you will have the option of playing a new sci-fi version of Mondrian Squares throughout the whole of May.  The new theme features two new soundtracks, a new backdrop, sci-fi themed tiles and special achievements.

May the 4th be with you.

Enjoy ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Valentine Vibes
notes.notes:
From Wednesday 1st February for 4 weeks you will have the option of playing a new Valentine version of Mondrian Squares, featuring a romantic soundtrack, a new backdrop and Valentine tiles.  Plus, don't forget to collect all the special Valentine achievements.

We will also have a weeklong deal from Monday 13th February, so why not buy a copy of Mondrian Squares for the gamer in your life?

Enjoy ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Festive Fun
notes.notes:
From Monday 19th December for 3 weeks you will have the option of playing a new festive version of Mondrian Squares, featuring a seasonal soundtrack, a new backdrop and festive tiles.

Don't forget to collect all the special festive achievements.

Enjoy ːsteamhappyː
